'''July 2001 Billings tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Billings, MT on 14 July 2001. Nathan won it. It is known from Travis Rumans's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2657">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-billings-mt-7-14-01d2657/ billings-mt-7-14-01], DeckTech (Travis "Com Igar" Rumans, 17 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-17-billings-mt-7-14-01d2657/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Billings, MT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' Nathan
